finding: services/incident/reference_validation.py _binding_window_errors gated only on incident created_at. The lineage trace DTO (GET /api/telemetry/lineage/events/<id>/trace) does not expose the target event's occurrence time; the existing owner GET /api/telemetry/events/<id> returns the immutable accepted event whose authoritative top-level time field is created_at.
change: When created_at is after binding retired_at, the incident qualifies only if every referenced telemetry event is resolved via GET /api/telemetry/events/<id> (event_id must match) and its top-level created_at (runtime generation time per telemetry_event.schema.json; event_time exists only inside correlation_envelope) is a valid RFC3339 UTC time within [effective_at, retired_at]. created_at is preserved unchanged; caller-supplied occurrence times are not used. Missing/unverifiable/outside-window event time, no event ids, or no lookup keeps the existing rejection. Before-effective, malformed created_at, identity, and lineage checks are unchanged. No new API, schema, store, clock or gate.
